task.description:
Implement API-10 (Rate limiting) per the design artefact at src/design/api-rate-limit.md.

Acceptance criteria:
- In-memory sliding-window rate limiter keyed by token identity
- Default limit: 1,000 req/min (configurable via BPM_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT env var)
- Per-token override configurable (see design for mechanism)
- HTTP 429 with Retry-After header when limit exceeded
- HTTP 429 responses MUST NOT reach the route handler (middleware short-circuits)
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0

Security requirements:
- No SQL string interpolation
- No secrets in source
- Thread-safe implementation (mutex or atomic operations as designed)

Note: Rate limiter runs AFTER auth middleware (only authenticated requests are counted). Use the token_id or token hash already resolved by auth middleware.
acceptance_criteria: src/api/middleware/rate_limit.zig (or as named in design) is created and compiles
Rate limiter is wired into the middleware chain
HTTP 429 + Retry-After returned when token exceeds limit
Default limit is 1,000/min from env var BPM_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT (fallback: 1000)

result.summary: Implemented API-10 (rate limiting): created src/api/middleware/rate_limit.zig with fixed-bucket sliding-window rate limiter keyed by AuthContext.token_id. Added token_id field to AuthContext in auth.zig (allocated for both bootstrap and DB-validated tokens). Added problemRateLimited constructor to errors.zig. Wired exports in main.zig and api_mod.zig. Fixed 3 existing auth unit tests to free the newly-allocated token_id/user_id fields.
